title: Installing Anvi'o using a Docker Image
author: James Thornton
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gejbtcn

steps.title: Install Docker Toolbox (Windows) or Docker for Mac
steps.instruction: Download Docker Toolbox version 1.12.2 for Windows (DockerToolbox-1.12.2.exe) from the Docker Toolbox download page, scroll down to the downloads section, and install using default settings without unchecking any options. Mac users should download and install the OS X Docker installer for Anvi’o from https://www.docker.com/products/docker-toolbox.

steps.title: Launch Docker Quickstart Terminal
steps.instruction: After installation, start Docker Quickstart Terminal (Windows shortcut on the desktop). Allow Docker to perform its initializations, answering “Yes” to any permission prompts that appear.

steps.title: Record the green IP address
steps.instruction: When initialization finishes, the terminal will display a green IP address; write this address down because it will be needed later (your IP will differ from the example shown).

steps.title: Run Anvi'o Docker image
steps.instruction: In the Docker Quickstart Terminal, execute the command `docker run -p 8080:8080 -it meren/anvio:latest` to download the necessary files and start the Anvi’o container.

steps.title: Verify Anvi'o prompt appears
steps.instruction: Wait until the terminal shows a prompt (as illustrated in the documentation), indicating the container is ready for commands.

steps.title: Execute Anvi'o self‑test
steps.instruction: At the container prompt, run `anvi-self-test` to perform the Anvi’o self‑test.

steps.title: Open Anvi'o in Chrome
steps.instruction: Open Google Chrome (download from https://www.google.com/chrome/browser/desktop/index.html if needed) and navigate to the recorded IP address followed by `:8080` (e.g., 192.168.99.100:8080).

steps.title: Terminate interactive session
steps.instruction: After confirming the example Anvi’o visualization loads, return to the terminal window and press Ctrl + C to stop the anvi‑interactive session.

steps.title: Proceed with own data
steps.instruction: Anvi’o is now installed; follow the official guidelines to bind your data directories for further analysis.
